screens.title: Westbridge University CCRS — Redesigned Sign In
screens.description: Clean, focused authentication interface featuring university branding, dual-column layout with campus photography, single sign-on (SSO) integration, institutional encryption badges, and password visibility toggle.

screens.title: CCRS Student Dashboard — Westbridge University
screens.description: Comprehensive student portal hub presenting academic progress, cumulative GPA metrics, current registered courses, upcoming timetable schedule, registration windows, and advisor alerts.

screens.title: Course Catalog — Westbridge University
screens.description: Advanced searchable and filterable course catalog with department facets, credit filters, prerequisite validation tags, syllabus previews, professor ratings, and one-click cart additions.

screens.title: Registration Cart — Westbridge University
screens.description: Interactive schedule staging cart featuring weekly calendar visualizer, conflict detection engine, credit limit counter, alternate section pickers, and checkout validation.

screens.title: Registration Confirmation — Westbridge University
screens.description: Formal enrollment confirmation page with confirmation reference ID, registered course summaries, payment/bursar breakdown, calendar sync options (Google/iCal/Outlook), and next step guides.

screens.title: Academic Record — Westbridge University
screens.description: Official transcript and degree audit view with term-by-term GPA analytics, credit completion distribution, graduation requirements tracker, and downloadable PDF transcript generator.

screens.title: Admin Overview — Westbridge University CCRS
screens.description: High-level administrative console displaying enrollment velocity, capacity heatmaps across faculties, waitlist metrics, registration system health, and quick override workflows.

screens.title: Manage Courses — Westbridge University CCRS Admin
screens.description: Administrative course lifecycle and section management interface with capacity adjusters, instructor assignments, classroom scheduling, prerequisite editing, and audit logging.
